topic: Milestone B: original node constructor and world registration remove NaN propagation from full stock vehicle camera callback
summary: Selected GTSi and bus VCF native-built camera attachments execute original default-camera callback and original world registration. Replacing zero root with original 0045EBD0 initialized root changes original 00437F90 from 9 to zero nonfinite float32 words and six camera doubles from NaN to all finite. 196 source-verified assertions and byte-identical independent replay. Full hardware numerical/physical camera parity remains open.

validation.notes: Original PE/Ghidra/ZFS digests, 31 exact opcode anchors, five original-instruction scenario trace identities including two byte-identical bus native registered camera replays, four VCF-to-active-registry pathways, 16-float 00437F90 and 6-double camera comparisons, provenance/source-to-summary checks. Finite camera does not establish x87 hardware or gameplay parity.

methods: Read accepted main protocol v1.0.3 and live ruleset before creating isolated run.
Verify original retail i76.exe PE, original ZFS and private annotated Ghidra GZF SHA256.
Independently extract byte-verified private VCF/VDF/GEO/TMT resource subset from original ZFS.
Run Ghidra 12.1.4 read-only original i386 native node constructor, original world registration, VCF builder and default camera for four scenarios.
Validate 31 exact executable instruction anchors and independent byte-identical Ghidra replay for selected native-root bus.
Independently parse source private execution traces and compare each derived public result row against the source, checking 196 assertions.
reproducibility.limitations: Requires separately held private original executable, ZFS, GZF and fixtures; original Windows heap, retail resources services and palette helpers intercepted. Original creator CALL not continuously executed into VCF; original camera callback explicitly invoked with synthetic frame timers and viewport. Sine/cosine and x87 float-to-int boundary substituted; Ghidra emitted x87 uninitialized-register warnings. Finite matrices/doubles not hardware numerical parity, authentic in-game camera pose, frame schedule or rasterization.
